skill.name: find-funding-calls
skill.description: Find open grants and funding calls a company qualifies for and build a spreadsheet sorted by deadline. Use when someone asks which funding programmes they can apply to.
skill.summary: Delegate funding research to MyClawn and request a spreadsheet of relevant open calls sorted by deadline.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a supporting job description, so the static finding is a false positive. The skill delegates research through a signed-in MyClawn connector and requires user review before tasks involving third-party writes. No evidence found of credential theft, unauthorized data exfiltration, or prompt injection in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/find-funding-ca

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 provides a supporting job-description URL with campaign tracking parameters, not instructions to transmit credentials or company records. The surrounding workflow describes user-requested funding research, which strongly supports benign reference use.

content.user_title: Find Funding Calls for Your Company
content.value_statement: Finding relevant grants requires checking open calls against company details and deadlines. This skill delegates research to MyClawn and requests a spreadsheet sorted by deadline.
actual_capabilities: Adapt a funding research task to the user's country, funders, and company description.
Delegate browser research through the signed-in MyClawn Computer connector.
Request programme names, funding purposes, deadlines, and source links in a spreadsheet sorted by deadline.
Require user review of task wording before sending tasks involving forms, bookings, or third-party writes.
Relay the connector's answer, final screenshot, and screen recording link.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; this skill does not include the connector or independent research tools.
Refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill for setup; that dependency is not included in the reviewed files.
Does not guarantee complete coverage, current deadlines, or final eligibility decisions.
Does not handle applications or solve captchas; those actions remain with the user.

use_cases.title: Research grants for a small software company
use_cases.description: Request open national and EU calls matching a software company's location and size, with deadlines and source links.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client funding shortlist
use_cases.description: Adapt the research brief to a client's country, funders, and company profile, then request a deadline-sorted spreadsheet.

use_cases.title: Organize an upcoming funding review
use_cases.description: Collect relevant programme names, funding purposes, deadlines, and links for a team to review before choosing applications.

prompt_templates.title: Find initial funding options
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open Austrian and EU funding calls for our five-person software company. Request programme names, funding purposes, deadlines, and links, sorted by deadline.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: request a first funding shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Customize the company profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open funding calls for a [headcount]-person [sector] company in [country], considering [funders]. Request a spreadsheet with programmes, funding purposes, deadlines, and links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: tailor research to a specific company.

prompt_templates.title: Constrain the research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [funders] on [official sites] for our [company description] in [country]. Request a deadline-sorted spreadsheet, flag unclear eligibility, and do not submit forms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: specify sources and research boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Define a review-ready delegation
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a MyClawn research task for [company profile], limited to [countries], [funders], and [sites]. Include spreadsheet fields, deadline ordering, unresolved eligibility, and no third-party writes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define a detailed task before delegation.

output_examples.input: Find grants for my company, but I have not provided company details.
output_examples.output: Which country is your company based in, what does it do, and how many people work there? Which funders should the research cover?

output_examples.input: Request a funding spreadsheet for our five-person Austrian software company, covering Austrian and EU calls.
output: Illustrative delivery format, not verified funding results.
Spreadsheet: [connector-provided file or link], sorted by deadline.
Fields: programme, what it funds, deadline, source link.
Research answer: [connector summary of relevant calls and unresolved eligibility].

best_practices: Provide the company location, sector, size, and preferred funders before delegating research.
Specify official sources and prohibit applications, form submissions, and third-party writes in the research brief.
Verify deadlines and eligibility on the linked programme pages before deciding which calls to pursue.
anti_patterns: Requesting company-specific eligibility research without a company profile or location.
Treating the resulting shortlist as guaranteed eligibility or complete coverage of available funding.
Using the research task to submit applications or bypass captchas without user involvement.

faq.question: What must be connected before using this skill?
faq.answer: The MyClawn Computer connector must be signed in. The skill refers to cloud-computer-task for setup and leaves sign-in to the user.

faq.question: Is the skill limited to Austrian and EU funding?
faq.answer: No. Austria and the EU are examples; the instructions say to replace the country, funders, and company description with your own.

faq.question: What does the requested spreadsheet contain?
faq.answer: It requests programme names, what each programme funds, deadlines, and links. Entries should be sorted by deadline.

faq.question: Does this skill submit funding applications?
faq.answer: No. Applications remain with you. The skill requires review of task wording before tasks involving forms, bookings, or third-party writes.

faq.question: Does it guarantee that my company qualifies?
faq.answer: No. The task requests relevant funding calls, but you must verify current eligibility rules and deadlines with each funder.

faq.question: What accompanies the research answer?
faq.answer: The workflow requests a final screenshot and a screen recording link from MyClawn. Captchas require your interaction on the live screen.
